name: Anadenanthera peregrina
summary: Anadenanthera peregrina is a documented other compound on PsychonautWiki.

uses.text: It has been used for ritual and healing purposes for thousands of years.

pharmacology.en: Its seeds contain tryptamines, mainly bufotenin with smaller amounts of DMT and 5-MeO-DMT. These act on serotonin receptors, especially 5-HT2A, which is how they change perception.
pharmacology.zh: 它的種子含有色胺類物質，主要是蟾蜍色胺，並有少量 DMT 與 5-MeO-DMT。這些物質作用於血清素受體，尤其是 5-HT2A，因而改變知覺。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它的种子含有色胺类物质，主要是蟾蜍色胺，并有少量 DMT 与 5-MeO-DMT。这些物质作用于血清素受体，尤其是 5-HT2A，因而改变知觉。

sideEffects.en: The snuff is strongly irritating to the nose and commonly causes burning pain, watering eyes, heavy mucus, nausea, vomiting and a raised heart rate and blood pressure. Confusion and frightening experiences are also reported.
sideEffects.zh: 這種粉末對鼻腔刺激性極強，常造成灼痛、流淚、大量鼻涕、噁心、嘔吐，以及心跳與血壓上升。也有混亂與驚恐經驗的回報。
sideEffects.zhHans: 这种粉末对鼻腔刺激性极强，常造成灼痛、流泪、大量鼻涕、恶心、呕吐，以及心跳与血压上升。也有混乱与惊恐经验的回报。

fact.en: Its seeds have been ground into snuff for thousands of years in South America and the Caribbean, known as yopo or cohoba. Carved snuff trays and bone tubes for it have been dug up at sites several thousand years old.
fact.zh: 大果柯拉豆的種子在南美與加勒比海地區被磨成鼻用粉末已有數千年歷史，稱為 yopo 或 cohoba。考古學家在數千年前的遺址中挖出過雕刻的粉盤與骨製吸管。
fact.zhHans: 大果柯拉豆的种子在南美与加勒比海地区被磨成鼻用粉末已有数千年历史，称为 yopo 或 cohoba。考古学家在数千年前的遗址中挖出过雕刻的粉盘与骨制吸管。
